parts.label: single
parts.note: Numerator: product -120, sum -7 gives -15 and 8, so 6x^2 - 7x - 20 = (3x + 4)(2x - 5); expanding checks. Denominator 4x^2 - 25 = (2x - 5)(2x + 5). Cancelling (2x - 5) gives (3x + 4)/(2x + 5); both agree.

key_verdict: No disagreement; the setter's key (3x + 4)/(2x + 5) is correct.
why: 'Simplify <algebraic fraction>' for 3 marks (factorise numerator, factorise difference of two squares, cancel) is a standard 4052 Paper 1 item; the leading coefficient 6 makes the trinomial a fair step up for the position, the numbers are exam-clean, and none of the exemplars is an algebraic-fraction simplification.
